comment: QUESTS.md F2, SPA-1 The Letters. The courier is an empty page without Spare and himself with him; eight letters posted out of TOWNS order, one walked to, each with its town's half and the saga line for its place in the order; the copies (item 73) and the trope on the first; Mrs Cotterill's writing page; the order variable; the copies read back from the menu in posting order; the dinner hour at the works, with a screenshot; Spare's story switch; her afterwards page with and without him.
